values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A Texas Railroad Commission approval in March 2023, described by an Arbo property records article, covers a 562-mile line from Midland County to the Golden Pass LNG terminal in Jefferson County, Texas. The October 2026 EIA pipeline projects release lists LNG as the demand served.

verifications.note: Says the Texas Railroad Commission approved Apex Pipeline to run from Midland County to the Golden Pass LNG terminal.
Apex row lists demand served as LNG and Beaumont and Port Arthur delivery area.

records.researcher_notes: Confirms the yes and the Golden Pass terminal already on the sheet. The line is on hold and its permit has not been renewed.

ledger.note: Arbo article and EIA release tie Apex to Golden Pass LNG; staged with refs.
Searched for a link between Access Northeast and an LNG export terminal. The project added a new LNG storage facility, but no source ties it to an export terminal, and the Everett link was dropped.

The EIA text and searches show no LNG export tie for this phase. Federal regulators said Atlantic Bridge was not built for LNG export, and Everett is an import terminal with no source linking it to this segment.
Searched anchor shipper and LNG export terms. The shippers are Tug Hill, an affiliate of the owner, and no source names an LNG export tie.
Searched for an LNG export tie and found none. The line moves Appalachian gas into Pennsylvania and no source names an LNG terminal.
The line was proposed to bring North Slope gas to Fairbanks. Searches found no source tying it to an LNG export terminal, only separate LNG trucking projects.
The EIA text and the Chesapeake Utilities release describe a pipeline feeding fuel cells for an Ohio data center. No LNG tie.

A Maritimes and Northeast expansion record is tied to the Canaport import terminal in Canada, and the Atlantic Bridge pieces were not built for LNG export. A Canadian export tie is not a US export tie, so the flag is left blank.
